environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; slender 'waist'; transparent, amber-tinted wings; vibrant yellow and black warning colors; high-gloss exoskeleton.

visual_logic.composition: A close-up of a wasp landing on the central cone of a primitive flower. The background is a soft-focus wash of purple Anacleto mudstone and green leaves. The wasp's wings are slightly vibrating, creating a delicate blur.
visual_logic.ground: A carpet of fallen flower petals over dusty ochre silt.
visual_logic.lighting: Warm, direct sun that makes the yellow bands on the wasp's body glow against the purple landscape.
